uniteMoveEffects.name: Rousing Symphony
uniteMoveEffects.originalDescription: The user vitalizes nearby allies and themself, increasing their damage by 15% for 6s. Afterward, the user unleashes a fiery bird in the designated direction, the range of which stretches across the whole arena. This move can be aimed for up to 10s before it needs to be reselected. While aiming the field of view is increased greatly. Unite buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield
